build_PrepareDataConfig: build a PrepareDataConfig dataclass to configure corpora, preprocessing, vocab, dedup, sharding, and launcher settings
create_CorporaConfig: create a CorporaConfig dataclass to define train, valid, and test dataset dictionaries for multilingual corpora
create_PreprocessingConfig: create a PreprocessingConfig dataclass to set lowercase, punctuation normalization, and special character handling options
create_DedupConfig: create a DedupConfig dataclass to configure deduplication by source, target, both, or neither with cross-fold support
create_ShardingConfig: create a ShardingConfig dataclass to set max examples per shard, smallest shard size, and binarization worker count
